title: Sign in to the console with password and email code
preconditions: The console is running at http://localhost:3000.
Use a fresh private/incognito browser window in which nobody is signed in to the console or the portal (both sites share one sign-in on this machine).
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000 in the browser.
steps.expected: You are taken to the page headed 'Sign in' with the text 'Sign in with your password, then the code sent to your email.' It shows the fields 'Email or username' and 'Password', a 'Sign in' button, a 'Forgotten your password?' link and, at the bottom, a 'Go to the consent portal' link.

steps.action: Type dpo@cmp.local in 'Email or username' and SeedPassw0rd!2026 in 'Password', then click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The page changes to 'Verify it is you' with the text 'Your role requires a second factor. We have sent a 6-digit code to your registered email.' There is a '6-digit code' box, a 'Verify and continue' button, a 'Send a new code' link and a 'Start over' link.

steps.action: Without typing a code, look at the 'Verify and continue' button. Then type only 3 digits into '6-digit code'.
steps.expected: 'Verify and continue' stays greyed out (disabled) until exactly six digits are entered. Letters typed into the box are ignored.

steps.action: Ask the test coordinator for the code sent to dpo@cmp.local (from the test outbox). Clear the box, type the six-digit code into '6-digit code' and click 'Verify and continue'. Do this within 5 minutes of step 2.
steps.expected: You are signed in and land on the Dashboard. The page heading reads 'Good day, Priya'.

steps.action: Look at the top right of the header.
steps.expected: The header shows the name 'Priya Menon' with a 'DPO' role badge and the initials 'PM'.

steps.action: Look at the left-hand sidebar.
steps.expected: The sidebar starts with the group 'Your work' - 'Dashboard', 'Rights requests', 'Breaches', 'My tasks', 'Projects', 'Notices' - followed by the groups Governance, Consent, Registry, Data movement and Oversight. Under Oversight there are 'Audit trail', 'Users', 'Delegations' and 'Message templates'. 'My profile' is not in the sidebar (it is in the account menu under your name at the top right), and notifications open from the bell in the header. A 'Sign out' button is at the bottom of the sidebar.

pass_criteria: The DPO can sign in only after entering both the password and the emailed six-digit code, and then lands on the dashboard greeted by first name with the DPO role shown.

title: Check each staff role lands on its own dashboard and menu
preconditions: A fresh private/incognito browser window with nobody signed in.
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000/sign-in. Type dco@cmp.local in 'Email or username' and SeedPassw0rd!2026 in 'Password' and click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The 'Verify it is you' page appears: the DCO also needs the second factor.

steps.action: Ask the test coordinator for the code sent to dco@cmp.local (from the test outbox), type it into '6-digit code' and click 'Verify and continue'.
steps.expected: The Dashboard opens with the heading 'Good day, Arun'. The header shows 'Arun Shetty' with the role badge 'Data Collection Owner'.

steps.action: Read the sidebar menu from top to bottom.
steps.expected: The menu shows exactly: Your work - Dashboard, My projects, Collection sites, Consent links, My tasks, Collections; Consent - Consents; Registry - Data sources; Data movement - Exports, Imports; Oversight - Delegations. There is no 'Approval documents', 'Notices', 'Purposes', 'Audit trail', 'Users' or 'Message templates'.

steps.action: In the address bar, open http://localhost:3000/users.
steps.expected: The users register is not shown. The sidebar stays, and the page shows a notice titled 'Not part of your account' reading 'This section belongs to a different role, so there is nothing here for you.' with a 'Back to your dashboard' button.

steps.action: Click 'Sign out' at the bottom of the sidebar.
steps.expected: You are returned to the 'Sign in' page.

steps.action: Sign in as admin@cmp.local with SeedPassw0rd!2026, then enter the code the test coordinator gives you for admin@cmp.local (from the test outbox) and click 'Verify and continue'.
steps.expected: The Dashboard opens with the heading 'Good day, System'. The header shows 'System Admin' with the role badge 'Administrator'.

steps.action: Read the sidebar menu.
steps.expected: The menu shows: Your work - Dashboard, Users, Grievances about the DPO, Message templates, Processors, Data sources, Audit trail; Oversight - Delegations; You - My tasks. There is no 'Projects', 'Consents' or 'Consent links'. The rights item is labelled 'Grievances about the DPO', not 'Rights requests'.

steps.action: Click 'Sign out'.
steps.expected: You are returned to the 'Sign in' page.

pass_criteria: Each role sees only the menu items for its role after sign-in, and the header shows the correct name and role badge.

title: Refuse a wrong password without saying which part was wrong
preconditions: A fresh private/incognito browser window with nobody signed in.
Do not make more than 3 wrong attempts on dpo@cmp.local in this case: 5 wrong attempts in 30 minutes lock the account (see ACC-05).
test_data: Real account: dpo@cmp.local with wrong password WrongPassword!1
Account that does not exist: nobody-here@cmp.local with password SeedPassw0rd!2026
Data principal (has no password): subject@cmp.local with password SeedPassw0rd!2026

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000/sign-in and click 'Sign in' without typing anything.
steps.expected: The form is not sent. Under 'Email or username' the message 'Enter your email address or username' appears, and under 'Password' the message 'Enter your password' appears.

steps.action: Type dpo@cmp.local in 'Email or username' and WrongPassword!1 in 'Password'. Click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: You stay on the 'Sign in' page. A red banner above the fields reads 'Those credentials are not valid'. No code page is shown.

steps.action: Change 'Email or username' to nobody-here@cmp.local, type SeedPassw0rd!2026 in 'Password' and click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The same red banner 'Those credentials are not valid' appears. The message does not say that the account does not exist.

steps.action: Change 'Email or username' to subject@cmp.local, type SeedPassw0rd!2026 in 'Password' and click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The same red banner 'Those credentials are not valid' appears. A data principal cannot sign in to the console.

steps.action: Now type dpo@cmp.local with the correct password SeedPassw0rd!2026 and click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The 'Verify it is you' code page appears, showing that the earlier failures did not block a correct sign-in. (You can click 'Start over' to stop here.)

pass_criteria: Every failed sign-in shows the same message 'Those credentials are not valid', whatever the reason, and the correct password still reaches the code step.

title: Refuse a wrong or replaced sign-in code on the console
preconditions: A fresh private/incognito browser window with nobody signed in.
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.
No more than 3 new codes may be requested for one account in 10 minutes.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000/sign-in, sign in with dpo@cmp.local and SeedPassw0rd!2026 and click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: The 'Verify it is you' page appears.

steps.action: Type 000000 into '6-digit code' and click 'Verify and continue'.
steps.expected: You stay on the code page. A red banner reads 'Invalid or expired code'.

steps.action: Ask the test coordinator for the code sent to dpo@cmp.local (from the test outbox) and write it down as Code A. Do not enter it yet. Click 'Send a new code'.
steps.expected: The link briefly reads 'Sending…', then a blue banner reads 'A new code has been sent. The previous one no longer works.' The code box is emptied.

steps.action: Type Code A into '6-digit code' and click 'Verify and continue'.
steps.expected: The old code is refused with the red banner 'Invalid or expired code'.

steps.action: Click 'Start over'.
steps.expected: You are back on the 'Sign in' page with the password form.

steps.action: Sign in again with dpo@cmp.local and SeedPassw0rd!2026, ask the test coordinator for the newest code sent to dpo@cmp.local (from the test outbox), type it and click 'Verify and continue'.
steps.expected: The newest code is accepted and the Dashboard opens with 'Good day, Priya'.

pass_criteria: A wrong code and a code replaced by 'Send a new code' are both refused with 'Invalid or expired code', and only the latest code signs the user in.

title: Lock a staff account after five wrong passwords
preconditions: Agree with the test coordinator before running: this locks rnd@cmp.local for about 30 minutes, so nobody else may need that account during that time.
A fresh private/incognito browser window with nobody signed in.
Nobody has signed in to rnd@cmp.local successfully and nobody has failed a sign-in to it in the last 30 minutes.
test_data: Email or username: rnd@cmp.local (Kavya Rao, R&D User)

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000/sign-in. Type rnd@cmp.local and NotThePassword!9 and click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: Red banner: 'Those credentials are not valid'.

steps.action: Repeat the same wrong attempt three more times (attempts 2, 3 and 4).
steps.expected: Each time the red banner reads 'Those credentials are not valid'.

steps.action: Make a fifth attempt with the same wrong password.
steps.expected: The red banner still reads 'Those credentials are not valid' (the lock is set now, but this answer does not reveal it).

steps.action: Now type the correct password SeedPassw0rd!2026 for rnd@cmp.local and click 'Sign in'.
steps.expected: Sign-in is refused even with the correct password. The red banner reads 'Too many failed attempts. Try again later. Try again in about 30 minutes.' (the number of minutes may be slightly lower). No code page is shown.

steps.action: Wait until the 30-minute lock has passed (or ask the test coordinator to confirm it has expired), then sign in with rnd@cmp.local and SeedPassw0rd!2026.
steps.expected: The 'Verify it is you' code page appears; the lock has lifted by itself without an administrator.

pass_criteria: After five wrong passwords the account refuses even the correct password with a 'Too many failed attempts' message for about 30 minutes, and then works again on its own.

title: Add a personal email and end another session from My profile
preconditions: rnd@cmp.local is not locked (ACC-05 not run in the last 30 minutes).
Two separate browsers (for example Chrome and Edge, or a normal and a private window) are available.
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.
test_data: Personal email to add: tester01-kavya@example.org (make it unique if already used)

steps.action: In browser 1, sign in to http://localhost:3000 as rnd@cmp.local with the password and code. Click your name at the top right to open the account menu, then click 'My profile'.
steps.expected: The page 'My profile' opens with three tabs - 'Contacts' (selected), 'Active sessions' with a count, and 'Password' - and the 'Identity' card beside them. Identity shows Name 'Kavya Rao', Role 'R&D User', Status 'Active' and a 'Session expires' time about 8 hours from now.

steps.action: On the 'Contacts' tab, look at the 'Work email' row.
steps.expected: It shows rnd@cmp.local with a 'Confirmed' badge. It has no 'Change', 'Add' or 'Remove' button.

steps.action: In the 'Personal email' row, click 'Add' (or 'Change' if one is already there). Type tester01-kavya@example.org in the 'Personal email' box and click 'Save and send a code'.
steps.expected: A green toast 'Saved' says 'We have sent a code to tester01-kavya@example.org.' The row shows the address with a 'Not confirmed' badge and a 'Six-digit code' box with 'Confirm' and 'Later' buttons.

steps.action: Type 000000 into 'Six-digit code' and click 'Confirm'.
steps.expected: A red message 'Invalid or expired code' appears in the row; the address stays 'Not confirmed'.

steps.action: Ask the test coordinator for the code sent to tester01-kavya@example.org (from the test outbox). Replace the digits with it and click 'Confirm'.
steps.expected: A green toast 'Confirmed' says 'tester01-kavya@example.org can now sign you in.' The row now shows a 'Confirmed' badge.

steps.action: In browser 2, sign in to http://localhost:3000 as rnd@cmp.local with the password and a new code. Go back to browser 1 and refresh the 'My profile' page and click the 'Active sessions' tab.
steps.expected: The tab's count is 2 or more, and a table lists the sessions with 'Device' (for example 'Chrome on Windows'), 'Address', 'Last active' and 'Expires'. The one for browser 1 is marked 'this device' and has no button; the other has an 'End session' button. 'End all other sessions' is shown above the table.

steps.action: In browser 1, click 'End session' on the other session.
steps.expected: A green toast 'Session ended' appears; that row disappears from the table and the tab's count drops to 1.

steps.action: In browser 2, click any sidebar item (for example 'My projects').
steps.expected: Browser 2 is sent to the 'Sign in' page: its session was ended from browser 1.

pass_criteria: A member of staff can add and confirm a personal email with the code sent to it, cannot edit the work email, and can end another of their own sessions from the 'Active sessions' tab.

title: Refuse sign-up for a person under 18 with no guardian route
preconditions: A fresh private/incognito browser window with nobody signed in.
The mobile below has never been registered.
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.
test_data: Date of birth: a date less than 18 years before today, e.g. 10 May 2012
Boundary check: the day after today's date 18 years ago (e.g. if today is 24 Sep 2026, use 25 Sep 2008)

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3001/sign-up. Fill in Full name 'Minor Tester', Mobile number '+91 98111 22302', leave Email address empty, and set Date of birth to 10 May 2012. Click 'Create account'.
steps.expected: No account is created and you stay on 'Create your account'. A red message says the person cannot be registered because they are under eighteen. The expected wording is 'We cannot register or record consent for a person under eighteen. If you think your date of birth is wrong, contact the Privacy Office.'

steps.action: Read the whole page, including the message and the hints.
steps.expected: Nothing on the page offers a parent, guardian or 'register on behalf of a child' option; the 'Confirm your contacts' step is not shown.

steps.action: Change Date of birth to the boundary date (one day short of 18 years ago) and click 'Create account' again.
steps.expected: The same refusal is shown: a person one day short of 18 is still refused.

steps.action: Click 'Sign in' at the bottom of the page. On the 'Sign in' page keep 'Mobile' selected, type +91 98111 22302 in 'Mobile number' and click 'Send me a code'.
steps.expected: The page shows 'Check your messages' and 'If +91 98111 22302 is registered with us, a six-digit code is on its way.' (the same neutral wording as for any number).

steps.action: Ask the test coordinator to check the test outbox for any message to +91 98111 22302.
steps.expected: The coordinator confirms that no registration code and no sign-in code was sent to that number: no account exists for it.

pass_criteria: A date of birth under 18 is refused at sign-up with a message that offers no guardian route, and no account or code is created for that mobile.

title: Ask for a missing date of birth at the next portal sign-in
feature: Date-of-birth prompt for accounts with no age on record
role: Account with no date of birth, as data principal on portal
preconditions: The test coordinator confirms that rco@cmp.local (Meera Iyer) has no date of birth recorded. If it already has one, the coordinator names another account with none.
A date of birth, once saved, cannot be removed from the screens, so this case can be run only once per account.
A fresh private/incognito browser window with nobody signed in.
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.
test_data: Future date to try first: 1 January 2030

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3001/sign-in, choose 'Email', type rco@cmp.local, click 'Send me a code', then enter the code the test coordinator gives you for rco@cmp.local (from the test outbox) and click 'Verify'.

steps.action: Click 'My requests' in the sidebar.
steps.expected: The page 'My requests' opens normally, with the same 'We need your date of birth' notice above it. Nothing blocks this page.

steps.action: Click 'Updates' in the sidebar.
steps.expected: Instead of the updates, a card headed 'Your date of birth' appears: 'The law protects people under 18 differently, and we do not have your date of birth yet. We need it before you can give a new consent.' It has a 'Date of birth' field, a 'Save and continue' button and links 'withdraw a consent' and 'make a request'.

steps.action: Click your name at the top right to open the account menu, then click 'My profile'.
steps.expected: The same 'Your date of birth' card appears instead of the account page.

steps.action: Click the 'make a request' link on the card.
steps.expected: 'My requests' opens without answering the question.

steps.action: Go back to 'My consents' and click 'Add it now' in the notice.
steps.expected: The 'Your date of birth' question is shown so the date can be added. (Record a defect if the link just reloads 'My consents'.)

steps.action: Open 'My profile' from the account menu to reach the 'Your date of birth' card. Type 1 January 2030 into 'Date of birth' and click 'Save and continue'.
steps.expected: The date is refused with 'Date of birth must be in the past' under the field; the card stays.

steps.action: Change 'Date of birth' to 21 July 1985 and click 'Save and continue'.

title: Sign in to the portal with a staff email and act only as a data principal
role: DPO signing in on the portal
preconditions: A fresh private/incognito browser window in which nobody is signed in to the console or the portal (a console session in the same window would send you to the console instead).
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.
test_data: If asked for a date of birth: 21 July 1985

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3001/sign-in, choose 'Email', type dpo@cmp.local and click 'Send me a code'.
steps.expected: 'Check your messages' appears with the 'Six-digit code' box. No password is asked for.

steps.action: Enter the code the test coordinator gives you for dpo@cmp.local (from the test outbox) and click 'Verify'.
steps.expected: You land on 'My consents'. A line across the top reads 'You are signed in with your staff account, as a data principal. Only your own consents, requests and rights are here; your console is a separate site.'

steps.action: Look at the header and sidebar.
steps.expected: The header shows 'Priya Menon' with the role badge 'Data Subject' (not 'DPO'). The sidebar has only 'My consents', 'My requests', 'My nominations', 'Updates' and 'Sign out'; 'My profile' is in the account menu.

steps.action: Click your name at the top right to open the account menu, then click 'My profile'. If the 'Your date of birth' card appears, enter 21 July 1985 and click 'Save and continue'.
steps.expected: 'My profile' opens. In Identity, Role shows 'Data Subject' and an 'Account' line reads 'Your staff account, used here as a data principal.' In Contacts, the 'Email' row shows dpo@cmp.local with the hint 'Your staff address, managed by your organisation. If you may lose it one day, add a personal one below.' and no 'Change' button.

steps.action: In the same window, open http://localhost:3000/users (the console).
steps.expected: No user list is shown. The console shows a page headed 'This console is for staff' reading 'You are signed in as Priya Menon. Your consents, your requests and your rights are on the consent portal.' with the buttons 'Go to the consent portal' and 'Sign out'.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000/sign-in in the same window.
steps.expected: The console sign-in form does not stay; you are sent to the portal (http://localhost:3001), because this window holds a data principal session.

steps.action: On the portal click 'Sign out'. Then sign in to the console at http://localhost:3000/sign-in as dpo@cmp.local with SeedPassw0rd!2026 and the emailed code.
steps.expected: The console asks for the password and the code, and only then shows the full DPO Dashboard with the 'DPO' badge. The portal code alone never gave DPO access.

pass_criteria: A staff email signs in to the portal with a code but the session is only a data principal's: it is labelled as the staff account, shows only the principal's own pages, and cannot open the console.

title: Add a second email on the portal and sign in with it once confirmed
preconditions: ACC-09 has been passed, so the tester owns the account Tester One (+91 98111 22301, tester01@example.org).
Signed in to the portal as Tester One in a private/incognito window.
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.
test_data: The account's own first email (should be refused as a second one): tester01@example.org
Email already used by another account: subject@cmp.local

steps.action: Click your name at the top right to open the account menu, then click 'My profile'.
steps.expected: 'My profile' opens. Contacts lists 'Email' (tester01@example.org, 'Confirmed', no Change button), 'Mobile' (with 'Change') and 'Second email' ('None given', with 'Add'). Identity shows a 'Session expires' time about 8 hours after you signed in.

steps.action: In the 'Second email' row click 'Add', type tester01@example.org and click 'Save and send a code'.
steps.expected: A red message in the row reads 'That is already the address on your account'.

steps.action: Replace it with subject@cmp.local and click 'Save and send a code'.
steps.expected: A red message reads 'That address belongs to another account'.

steps.action: Replace it with tester01-personal@example.org and click 'Save and send a code'.
steps.expected: Green toast 'Saved': 'We have sent a code to tester01-personal@example.org.' The row shows the address with 'Not confirmed' and a 'Six-digit code' box with 'Confirm' and 'Later'.

steps.action: Click 'Later'. Then click 'Sign out'. On 'Sign in', choose 'Email', type tester01-personal@example.org and click 'Send me a code'.
steps.expected: The neutral 'Check your messages' notice appears, but the test coordinator confirms that no sign-in code was sent to tester01-personal@example.org: an unconfirmed address cannot sign anyone in.

steps.action: Click 'Use a different contact' and sign in with the mobile +91 98111 22301 and its code from the test coordinator. Open 'My profile' from the account menu.
steps.expected: The 'Second email' row shows tester01-personal@example.org with 'Not confirmed' and a 'Send a code' button.

steps.action: Click 'Send a code'. Enter the code the test coordinator gives you for tester01-personal@example.org and click 'Confirm'.
steps.expected: Green toast 'Confirmed': 'tester01-personal@example.org can now sign you in.' The row shows 'Confirmed' and a 'Remove' button.

steps.action: Click 'Sign out'. Sign in with 'Email' tester01-personal@example.org and the code the test coordinator gives you for it.
steps.expected: You are signed in as Tester One and land on 'My consents'.

pass_criteria: A second email is added only after its own code is confirmed, cannot sign in before that, can sign in afterwards, and duplicates of own or another account's address are refused.

title: End a portal session after 30 minutes without activity
preconditions: A fresh private/incognito browser window with nobody signed in.
The tester can leave the browser untouched for at least 31 minutes.
The test coordinator can read the test outbox.

steps.action: Sign in to http://localhost:3001 with 'Mobile' +91 90000 00001 and the code the test coordinator gives you. Open 'My profile' from the account menu (your name at the top right) and note the 'Session expires' time in Identity.
steps.expected: 'My profile' opens. 'Session expires' is about 8 hours after the sign-in time (the absolute limit).

steps.action: Click 'My consents'. Then leave the browser completely untouched (no clicks, no typing, do not switch to this window) for 31 minutes.
steps.expected: Nothing visible happens while you wait.

steps.action: After 31 minutes, return to the window and, if you are still on 'My consents', click 'My requests'.
steps.expected: Your data is not shown any more. As soon as you return to the window, or at the latest when you click, you are taken to the portal 'Sign in' page (the address carries 'next='), because the session ended after 30 minutes without activity.

steps.action: Sign in again with the mobile and a new code from the test coordinator.
steps.expected: You are signed in again and land on the page named in the address ('My consents' or 'My requests'), not on a blank or error page.

pass_criteria: A portal session left unused for more than 30 minutes ends by itself and the next action leads to sign-in, well before the 8-hour absolute limit.
